# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Best overall: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS' top pick under $200. Its ANC competes with Sony and Bose flagships.
- It has 60 hours of battery, multipoint, and LDAC support.
- It clamps hard and the headband padding is mediocre, so it may be uncomfortable on larger heads.
- It sometimes sits just under $200 on sale, so check the current price.
- Buy: [RTINGS review with Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart price links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45**
- It's around $100 and has excellent noise isolation, with about 28 hours of battery.
- RTINGS notes some hiss with ANC on and user reports of headband or hinge breakage.
- Buy: [RTINGS review with Amazon and Walmart links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus**
- It has smooth, bass-forward tuning, a parametric EQ in the app, and 56 hours of battery.
- Its ANC is weaker than the others, especially on low rumble like plane engines. It also lacks headband padding.
- Buy: [RTINGS review with Amazon, Best Buy and B&H links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for calls and strong ANC: Sony ULT WEAR (about $200)**
- RTINGS picks it for calls. SoundGuys measured the strongest low-frequency cancellation of its group, plus multipoint and LDAC.
- Buy: [RTINGS review with Best Buy, Amazon and Walmart links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Cheapest option: JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80)**
- It has a 44-hour battery, but ANC is the weakest of the group. It takes the edge off a bus or office, not a flight.
- Tom's Guide rates it best under $100. Buy: [Tom's Guide roundup with retailer links](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

**Also worth a look**
- **Sony WH-CH730N:** About $176–$178 at Amazon and Best Buy. Tom's Guide praises its sound, ANC and comfort but calls the US price too high. [Review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)
- **Soundcore Space One Pro:** Tom's Guide's best under $200, with soft ear cups. [Roundup](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **CMF Headphone Pro:** The sturdiest budget pick, with stainless steel hinges. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**My pick:** The JBL Live 780NC if you can find it under $200, otherwise the Soundcore Space Q45 for the price. If you have an iPhone, skip LDAC as a selling point, since Apple devices don't support it.

**Caveats**
- I couldn't open retailer pages, so the links go to review pages with price buttons rather than direct product listings. Prices vary by retailer and sale, and the SoundGuys prices (via [RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)) date from March.
- That same article lists the JBL Live 670NC at $130. It praises the sound, but Tom's Guide found its ANC weak, so I left it out.

Do you want me to narrow this down by phone type (iPhone or Android), comfort, or a lower budget?
